audit: erun terraform destroy --dry-run team dev
terraform: destroy in <TMP> (env team/dev, namespace team-dev)
terraform: var file dev.tfvars
cd <TMP> && terraform init -input=false
cd <TMP> && terraform plan -destroy -input=false -var-file=dev.tfvars -out apply.tfplan
terraform: destroy requires typing the environment name (dev) to confirm before apply
cd <TMP> && terraform apply -input=false apply.tfplan
